style: 年齢感・髪・衣装は今回の美術設定。本文の経歴や名前を追加する設定ではなく、騎士エルドと船大工を志す成人の姪を描く。両者の手は空で、盾の所在は場面本文に従う。

files.prompt_en: A full-body character sprite for a hand-painted fantasy exploration RPG. One adult knight named Eld, depicted as a mature man with short iron-grey hair, a neatly trimmed salt-and-pepper beard, a composed thoughtful face and a sturdy natural build. He stands in a relaxed three-quarter conversational pose at ease. He wears a muted plum long-sleeved tunic, an earth-brown sleeveless fitted waistcoat with simple brass clasps, a plain belt, charcoal trousers and sturdy dark leather boots. Both hands are empty and rest naturally at his sides. Restrained, finely painted digital illustration with softly textured cloth and leather, warm gentle directional lighting, and a clearly readable silhouette. Center the entire person on a 1024 by 1536 portrait canvas, with head, fingertips and boot tips fully framed and generous transparent margins. Every pixel outside the person and clothing silhouette is fully transparent; the visible painting belongs entirely to the person and clothing.
files.prompt_ja: 手描きのファンタジー探索RPG用の全身立ち絵。成人の騎士エルドが一人。成熟した男性として、短い鉄灰色の髪、整えた白髪交じりのひげ、落ち着いた思慮深い顔、がっしりした自然な体格で描く。くつろいだ斜め向きの会話姿勢で立つ。くすんだプラム色の長袖チュニック、簡素な真鍮留め具を備えた土茶色の体に沿う袖なし胴着、無地の帯、チャコール色のズボン、丈夫な暗い革のブーツを着用する。両手は空で体の横に自然に下ろす。控えめで精緻なデジタル絵画、柔らかな布と革の質感、穏やかで温かな斜光、読み取りやすい輪郭。1024×1536の縦長画面中央に人物全体を置き、頭・指先・靴先まで収めて十分な透明の余白を取る。人物と衣服の輪郭の外側の全画素を完全な透明とし、見える絵画は人物と衣服のみに属する。

files.prompt_en: A full-body character sprite for a hand-painted fantasy exploration RPG. One young adult woman, Eld's niece who intends to become a shipwright. She has short dark auburn hair tucked neatly behind her ears, a calm determined expression, and natural adult proportions. She stands in a relaxed three-quarter conversational pose. She wears a clean pale teal long-sleeved linen blouse, a muted ochre short fitted jacket, a simple brown belt, deep-blue trousers and practical dark-brown lace-up boots. Both hands are empty and relaxed beside her body, with one open palm in a modest conversational gesture. Restrained, finely painted digital illustration with softly textured cloth and leather, warm gentle directional lighting, and a clearly readable silhouette. Center the entire person on a 1024 by 1536 portrait canvas, with head, fingertips and boot tips fully framed and generous transparent margins. Every pixel outside the person and clothing silhouette is fully transparent; the visible painting belongs entirely to the person and clothing.
